claims.claim: Ukrainian military terminals lost service above roughly 100 mph on Tuesday night with no advance warning.
claims.episode_span: Ukrainian military terminals lost service above roughly 100 mph on Tuesday night with no advance warning, and the 7th Rapid Reaction Corps reported 10-to-20-second dropouts even at lower speeds that made drone control difficult.
claims.supporting_quote: Ukrainian military Starlink terminals started dropping service above roughly 100 mph on Tuesday night.

claims.claim: The 7th Rapid Reaction Corps reported 10-to-20-second dropouts even at lower speeds that made drone control difficult.
claims.episode_span: Ukrainian military terminals lost service above roughly 100 mph on Tuesday night with no advance warning, and the 7th Rapid Reaction Corps reported 10-to-20-second dropouts even at lower speeds that made drone control difficult.
claims.supporting_quote: The 7th Rapid Reaction Corps told Reuters that connections cut out for 10 to 20 seconds even at speeds well below the limit, which made drones harder to control.

claims.claim: Musk replied on X that the US military and president decide any limits on the government-owned Starshield network.
claims.episode_span: Musk replied on X that the US military and president decide any limits on the government-owned Starshield network, while commercial Starlink remains restricted to civilian or defensive use only.
claims.source_title: Elon Musk breaks his silence on the Starlink impact to Ukraine drones
claims.supporting_quote: Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS.

claims.claim: Each five-segment booster will deliver more than 75 percent of total SLS thrust at liftoff.
claims.episode_span: Each five-segment booster will deliver more than 75 percent of total SLS thrust at liftoff.
claims.source_title: Artemis III progress ahead of SLS pad testing
claims.supporting_quote: Each forward assembly includes the nose cone, a forward skirt housing avionics, and a frustum containing the separation motors. The boosters, built by Northrop Grumman, will deliver more than 75 percent of total SLS thrust at liftoff from Pad 39B.

claims.claim: The Sabatier reaction runs at 300–400 °C over a nickel or ruthenium catalyst and yields methane plus water.
claims.episode_span: The reaction runs at 300–400 °C over a nickel or ruthenium catalyst and yields methane plus water; the water is then electrolyzed to recover the hydrogen and generate the oxygen needed for the 3.6:1 oxidizer-to-fuel ratio.
claims.supporting_quote: The Sabatier reaction or Sabatier process produces methane and water from a reaction of hydrogen with carbon dioxide at elevated temperatures (optimally 300–400 °C) and pressures (perhaps 3 megapascals; 440 psi; 30 bar [ 1 ] ) in the presence of a nickel catalyst .

claims.claim: A membrane Sabatier system improves yield by continuously removing the water vapor in situ.
claims.episode_span: A membrane Sabatier system improves yield by continuously removing the water vapor in situ, allowing the reaction to proceed further toward completion even under intermittent solar power.
claims.source_title: A membrane Sabatier system for water recovery and rocket propellant production
claims.supporting_quote: Herein, we introduce a membrane Sabatier system by integrating a catalytic reactor with an H 2 O vapor permselective membrane tube. We achieve a substantial increase in CO 2 conversion, a high CH 4 yield and excellent long-term stability via highly efficient in-situ water removal.

claims.claim: Scaling the system to supply a full Starship stack requires roughly 1,150 tonnes of methane per flight.
claims.episode_span: Scaling the system to supply a full Starship stack requires roughly 1,150 tonnes of methane per flight, which the same closed-loop water recovery can sustain without importing additional hydrogen.
claims.source_title: Starship stands roughly as tall as a 40-storey building and carries more than 5,000 tonnes of liquid methane and oxygen.
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX lists the current full stack at 124 metres tall, with capacity for 1,600 tonnes of propellant in the upper ship and 3,650 tonnes in Super Heavy. Together that is 5,250 tonnes of liquid methane and liquid oxygen at full capacity.
